overall: Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding an unposted, unminuted June 1, 2010 meeting with counsel on litigation strategy, but no deliberation on the license vote was found. Rescission was not ordered because the violation predated AG enforcement; the Board was only encouraged to comply with the revised law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in executive session on June 1, 2010 without posting notice or following the procedures required to enter executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the law by failing to post a notice of its meeting, by failing to open the meeting to the public or convening an executive session, and failing to take minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated toward or decided whether to grant an outdoor entertainment license for Hotel Indigo at the June 1, 2010 private meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, the Board does not appear to have deliberated, as that term applied pursuant to G.L. c. 39, §23B, on a vote during its June 1, 2010 meeting.
